{{Quote|You fell so eagerly into my trap!|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]|<ref name="Terror on the Twilight" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] launched a '''mission''' to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Deyvus]]'' to save the apparently endangered civilian [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
